log_warning_colored: log a warning message with optional ANSI color to stderr when running in a terminal
log_info_colored: log an info message with optional ANSI color to stderr when running in a terminal
log_termination_reason: pretty-print an agentflow option termination status update with color-coded success, failure, or preempted messages
use_ANSI_COLORS: access the ANSI_COLORS dictionary to apply terminal color codes like pink, blue, green, yellow, red, bold, or underline
use_nullcontext: use the nullcontext helper as a no-op context manager for conditional context management
